l.i: Icon hæc non à Rondeletio posita, sed à Veneto pictore nobis effictu est.

main_text.l: ANGLICE. Rhombum marinum in meridionali Britannici maris litore uocamus a Flounder, (& fluuiatilem a freshwater Flounder,) ut eundem piscem in Septentrionali litore Flüke uocamus, Turnerus. Bellonius non Rhombum, sed Passerem fluuiatilem, Gallice Flez, Anglice Flonder uocari tradit.

page.notes: The page carries a woodcut of a flatfish (flounder) with fins and tail, occupying the centre of the page; it is not transcribed. The caption below the picture is set in lines of mixed roman and italic type with some words in bold; the bold words are shown in italics where relevant. Some letters in the caption are damaged and read with uncertainty, notably "Flüke" and "Flonder".
